item.text: [{"task_id":"f8ff0b80","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    order_weight = float(params['rule'][1])","    width = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    ranked = []","    for value in np.unique(grid):","        colour = int(value)","        if colour != background:","            size = int(np.count_nonzero(grid == colour))","            ranked.append((order_weight * size, colour))","    ranked.sort()","    return np.array([[colour] * width for score, colour in ranked], dtype=int)"],"shapes":{"rule":[3]},"params":{"rule":[0,-1,1]},"rationale":"Exclude the background and rank colours by descending pixel count, returning one colour per row.
